{{velocity output="false"}} ## Single definition of which pages are retrieved as tasks by the macros and pages that list tasks (task report, gantt, ## kanban board, task manager home page, task panel). Include this page instead of writing a dedicated query. ## ## Inline tasks (created with the task macro, having the 'owner' property set) are hidden pages, so the 'hidden' query ## filter must NOT be used when retrieving tasks. Note that the 'liveTable' Live Data source applies it by default, so ## the $taskQueryFilters have to be passed explicitly to it through the 'queryFilters' source parameter.
## Constraint that every task query must contain. It excludes the task templates. #set ($taskQueryBaseConstraint = "doc.space <> 'TaskManager.TaskManagerTemplates'") ## Query filters that every task query must use. #set ($taskQueryFilters = ['currentlanguage', 'unique'])
#** * Creates the XWQL query retrieving the task pages. * * @param $constraints XWQL fragment appended after the base constraint, so it must start with 'and' or 'order by'; the * task object is aliased as 'task' * @param $return the name of the variable that will hold the query *# #macro (createTaskQuery $constraints $return) #set ($taskQueryStatement = "from doc.object(TaskManager.TaskManagerClass) as task where $taskQueryBaseConstraint") #if ("$!constraints" != '') #set ($taskQueryStatement = "$taskQueryStatement $constraints") #end #set ($taskQuery = $services.query.xwql($taskQueryStatement)) #foreach ($taskQueryFilter in $taskQueryFilters) #set ($taskQuery = $taskQuery.addFilter($taskQueryFilter)) #end #setVariable("$return" $taskQuery) #end
## HQL fragments joining the 'owner' property of the task object, aliased as 'obj' by the live table results. Append ## them to the query only when the task type constraint is not empty, with 'taskTypeOwner.value' as owner value. #set ($taskOwnerHqlFrom = ', StringProperty as taskTypeOwner') #set ($taskOwnerHqlWhere = "and taskTypeOwner.id.id = obj.id and taskTypeOwner.id.name = 'owner'")
#** * Creates the constraint restricting the retrieved tasks to a type: standalone tasks, inline tasks or both. * * @param $taskType the type of the tasks to retrieve: 'all', 'standalone' or 'inline', case-insensitive; when empty, * the type configured in the administration is used * @param $ownerValue the query expression holding the value of the task 'owner' property, e.g. 'task.owner' in XWQL * @param $return the name of the variable that will hold the constraint, empty or starting with 'and' *# #macro (getTaskTypeConstraint $taskType $ownerValue $return) #set ($taskTypeValue = "$!taskType") #if ($taskTypeValue == '') #set ($taskTypeValue = "$services.task.configuration.displayedTaskType") #end ## Oracle stores empty strings as null, hence the null check and the "like '_%'" check of non-empty owners. #if ($taskTypeValue.equalsIgnoreCase('standalone')) #set ($taskTypeConstraint = "and ($ownerValue is null or $ownerValue = '')") #elseif ($taskTypeValue.equalsIgnoreCase('inline')) #set ($taskTypeConstraint = "and $ownerValue like '_%'") #else #set ($taskTypeConstraint = '') #end #setVariable("$return" $taskTypeConstraint) #end {{/velocity}}
